rv.q: This intelligent, finely crafted show will probably be best appreciated by the adults in the room, yet there is plenty to intrigue, even delight the youngsters.
Perhaps it’s overly whimsical, a little too reverent to the source, and could certainly lean more heavily into opportunities for reinvention.
This is a rabbit hole well worth falling into.
A feast for the eyes, it produced audible gasps as well as laughs, which is as good a reason as any to go and see it.
To look at, this production is breathtaking.
